Q8137.reason: The act of State doctrine is judicial abstention: domestic courts will not sit in judgment on a foreign State's public acts done within its own territory, which functions as immunity for those acts.

Q5849.reason: A bare claim that computer records were kept in the regular course of business does not satisfy FRE 803(6) and 901; the court needs further foundation on how the records were made and that the system is reliable.

Q5779.reason: An unused peripheral cannula is commonly flushed with 0.9% saline at least every 8 hours, and also before and after each use, to keep it patent.
